description: Which parts of a memory a reader may change in TmMemoryPanel's inline editor, as a flags set. The set is the host's permission, not a suggestion: a field whose flag is missing is neither rendered nor reported, so a store that owns the category (a taxonomy an agent classifies into) can still let the reader fix the text. Text is the default, which is exactly the pre-2.11.0 editor; Category and Source add their field beside it and report through OnEditItem; None removes the Edit action entirely.
